features: outdoor pan/tilt 4G LTE camera, 1080p Full HD, 360 degree horizontal / 130 degree vertical coverage
4G LTE bands FDD B1/3/5/7/8/20/28, TDD B38/40/41 (nano-SIM); dual mode 4G or PoE
color night vision + 850 nm IR LED to 29.9 m; starlight, IP66 weatherproof
AI person/pet/vehicle, tamper, line-crossing detection with 360 degree motion tracking and patrol mode
two-way audio with noise cancellation, 99 dB sound-and-light alarm, dual dimmable spotlights
microSD up to 512 GB or Tapo Care cloud; RTSP and ONVIF (Ethernet mode), Alexa / Google Assistant

frigate.notes: RTSP/ONVIF available only in Ethernet (wired) mode. Enable the camera account/ONVIF in the Tapo app. Streams: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub).

home_assistant.notes: Native TP-Link Tapo integration. Requires Tapo cloud account credentials.

blue_iris.notes: Use Generic/ONVIF profile (Ethernet mode). RTSP: /stream1 (main), /stream2 (sub). Enable ONVIF in Tapo app.
